title: Require Public Domain Surfaces In Recipes And Maps
forbids: recipe or map source importing domain code outside the domain root, ops, artifacts, named model schema/policy modules, or one named model data collection
why: Recipes compose domains through named public surfaces, not relative reaches, shared buckets, broad data buckets, operation-local files, or private implementation modules.
message: Recipe and map source may import domain code only through the domain root, ops, artifacts, named model schema/policy modules, or a named model data collection.
